hotels.title: Luminous Heritage Versailles Escape Minutes from the Palace with Onsite Restaurant
hotels.description: Just steps from the magnificent Palace of Versailles, this contemporary hotel is tucked away right in the city's sweet spot. The elegant rooms and suites offer the perfect place to retreat after exploring Versailles' treasures, each with plush bedding, Nespresso coffee machines and Clarins bath products. Enjoy classic French cuisine at L'Alcôve restaurant, or relax with a drink overlooking historic views on La Terrassee, the hotel's sunny jewel. Spend days palace-hopping, browsing artisan local markets, or getting lost in the knockout Palace's gardens, before returning to Hôtel Le Louis Versailles Château - MGallery to rest and recover in the wellness space, complete with hammam, sauna and sensorial shower.
